name: loop-monorepo
//trustedDependencies: bun skips postinstall scripts unless a package is listed here. electron ships only a JS shim without its postinstall and fails at launch with 'Electron failed to install correctly'.

scripts.build: bun run gen:catalog && bun run gen:docs && bun run --filter @notshekhar/loop-sandbox build && bun run --filter @notshekhar/loop-web build && bun run --filter @notshekhar/loop-core build && bun run --filter @notshekhar/loop-tui build && bun run --filter @notshekhar/loop build
scripts.link: bun run --filter @notshekhar/loop build && cd packages/cli && bun link
scripts.//typecheck: Every bundler here transpiles without checking, so a type error reaches a release unless this runs. tsgo for the two app packages, tsc for the rest.
scripts.//test: Scoped: a bare `bun test` also collects apps/web, whose suite is vitest-only and hangs the process under bun. The web app has its own `test` script.
scripts.test: bun run typecheck && bun test packages apps/desktop && bun run --filter @loop/web test
scripts.//test:screens: Runs loop in a real pty and asserts on the screen — the only tests that catch a correct frame drawn in the wrong place.
